title: fix(app-shell): the Studio canvas runs a report or widget over a draft dataset before the package publishes

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgP6XkfpjCfyzzG2KwQPUZfy)_

Fixes #27585

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 画布上的报表与仪表盘组件查询数据集时带上草稿标记，草稿数据集在包发布前就能出数；`queryDataset` 新增可选参数 `previewDrafts`。
- 为什么改：作者在 Studio 新建数据集并绑定报表或图表后，画布提示「数据集在此环境中未定义」，直到发布才显示，而旁边的选择器早已能读到这份草稿。
- 风险与回滚：只影响 Studio 内的报表/仪表盘预览；控制台运行时和 Setup 编辑器的请求一字节不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`canvasDataSource.ts`（画布数据源）、`data-objectstack/src/index.ts` 的 `queryDataset` 参数一段、`canvasDataSource-27585.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/canvasDataSource-27585.test.tsx`，预期 5 个测试全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The defect.** In the Studio, a report or a dashboard widget bound to a dataset that is still a draft said the dataset "is not defined in this environment" until the package published. `queryDataset` decided the draft world only from the page URL's `?preview=draft`, and the Studio canvas is a draft window that does not carry that flag, so its query went to the published world, where a draft-only dataset does not exist. The dataset pickers beside the canvas already read the draft-overlaid catalog (#27518).

**`@object-ui/data-objectstack`: `queryDataset(dataset, selection, options?)`.** A new optional `{ previewDrafts?: boolean }`. `true` puts `previewDrafts: true` on the one dataset-query request, exactly what the URL flag already put there; the server then resolves the dataset from the draft overlay. It is the same explicit option `listViews(objectName, { previewDrafts })` takes. Absent, the page URL decides as before; given, it wins over the URL. A caller that passes nothing sends a byte-identical request.

**`@object-ui/app-shell`: the canvas data source.** `ReportPreview` and `DashboardPreview` render through `useCanvasDataSource()` (new, internal, `previews/canvasDataSource.ts`). In the Studio, keyed on the signal the dataset pickers read (`StudioDatasetAuthoringContext`, provided by the Interfaces pillar around the canvas), it hands the runtime renderers the adapter with its `queryDataset` asking for `previewDrafts`; every other member is the adapter's own, bound to it. Outside the Studio (Setup's editors) it hands back the adapter unchanged. The shape follows the Form tab preview's data source in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (`formPreviewSource`): the preview hands the runtime renderer a data source rather than threading a flag through `plugin-report` and `plugin-dashboard`, so every dataset query those renderers make (the report, a dataset widget, a dataset-bound chart, a filter bar's options) carries it with no change in either plugin. One source per adapter is kept in a module `WeakMap`, so its identity is the adapter's and never a `useMemo` result (ui/AGENTS.md #10).

**The ruling.** "⛔ The canvas resolves draft datasets the same way the draft preview resolves other draft metadata. It does not add a second lookup." The draft preview resolves draft metadata with one request-level flag the server honours (`?preview=draft` on `/meta`, `previewDrafts` on the dataset query). The canvas now sends that same flag on the same request. The dataset is still named and only the server resolves it: no client-side read of the draft definition, no inline post of it.

## Measurements (the order's mechanism assumptions)

- **(a) The server's dataset door honours the flag for a draft-only dataset: yes (code read, not run live).** `packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts`, the `POST /analytics/dataset/query` handler: `previewDrafts` is `body.previewDrafts === true` or `?preview=draft`, admitted only for a caller `mayReadPendingDrafts` admits; the by-name lookup reads `getMetaItems({ type: 'dataset', previewDrafts })`, the draft-overlaid list in which draft-only items surface, then hands `previewDrafts` on to `svc.queryDataset`. It is the one owner of that path in the tree. No server file changes.
- **(b) The canvas's draft signal.** `useStudioDatasetAuthoring()` (`studio-design/datasetCreate.tsx`), the context the Interfaces pillar provides around both the inspector and the canvas. `DashboardWidgetInspector` and `ReportDefaultInspector` read it to ask `useDatasetCatalog` for `previewDrafts` since #27518; the canvas previews now read the same one.
- **(c) The console runtime stays published.** `DashboardView` and `ReportView` render with the plain adapter and pass no option, so `queryDataset` still follows the page URL only: no flag on a runtime page, the flag inside the app draft preview, as before.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/canvasDataSource-27585.test.tsx` (new). Through the real `ObjectStackAdapter` (fetch stubbed) and the real `plugin-report` / `plugin-dashboard` renderers. The stub server answers the dataset by name only when the request carries `previewDrafts: true`, and otherwise answers the door's own `404 NOT_FOUND`, which is what the door does for a draft-only dataset.
  - In the Studio context, the report preview and the dashboard preview post `{ datasetName: 'draft_sales', previewDrafts: true }` on every dataset query and draw the draft's rows.
  - Without the context, the same previews post no `previewDrafts` and draw no rows.
  - `datasetDraftsSource` is one source per adapter, binds every other member to the adapter, and merges `previewDrafts` into a caller's own options.
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/queryDataset.test.ts`, new block "the draft world (objectstack#27585)": the option with no URL flag sends `previewDrafts: true`; neither sends nothing; the URL flag alone still sends it; an explicit `previewDrafts: false` wins over the URL flag.

## Acceptance notes

- **Who gets drafts.** The server serves the draft world only to a caller it admits to drafts (`mayReadPendingDrafts`); anyone else gets the published dataset, as if the flag were absent. A Studio author is admitted by construction.
- **Not in this PR, and not the same option.** The card's "related, code-read only" note (Setup's dataset designer field catalog, `useDatasetFields`, reading objects without the draft overlay) is a metadata read, not a dataset query; this option does not reach it. Left as the card noted it.
- **Overlap.** #27713 also edits `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` (the record-page open request, another region). This diff in that file is the `queryDataset` docblock and its option only; whichever lands second rebases.
- **Assignee and reviewers.** None set by this PR's author, by the dispatch rule: the seat asks once its review is in.
